claim: Turning your handwriting into a real font went to one photo and zero upload for Latin scripts (draw-your-font, 535 stars in 5 days) — but a Chinese font still needs ~6,763 hand-written glyphs, and few-shot glyph completion is nobody's product.
method: GitHub API age/stars/forks check (created 2026-07-22, 535 stars, 54 forks); read the repo's open issues; pulled the FontCrafter HN thread (482 points, 157 comments) via the Algolia API for first-hand comments; web search on the Chinese glyph-count barrier.
does: Photograph a filled-in template of your own handwriting and it produces an installable TTF/WOFF font locally — Node CLI plus a Claude Code skill, nothing uploaded.
edge: No account, no server, no upload: the most personal artefact a person has stays on their machine and comes back as a file they own.
why_use: A person's handwriting is one of exactly two things about them that cannot be reproduced (the other is their voice). Turning a living relative's hand into a font makes every printed card, couplet and family letter carry it.
gap: Chinese handwriting fonts still require thousands of manual glyphs, and few-shot glyph completion is not productized.
counter: Type foundries already sell handwriting-style Chinese fonts and have the pipeline; few-shot glyph synthesis at usable quality is a real research risk, and a bad generated stroke reads as obviously wrong to a native reader.
differentiator: Attack the glyph gap, not the font export: write 300 characters, generate the common 1,000, and ship one emotionally finished artefact (a spring couplet or a family letter set in grandma's hand) rather than a font file. Cold start (Chinese): the comment sections under 手写字体制作 tutorials on Xiaohongshu and Bilibili, which are full of people who gave up halfway, plus the follow-up questions under the Zhihu answer 如何制作一款自己的中文字体. Cold start (English): r/fonts and r/typography, search 'handwriting font'.
value: Pay per font, with printed goods (couplets, keepsake books, cards) as the recurring purchase.
risk: Quality of synthesised Chinese glyphs is the whole product; if strokes look off, the emotional payload inverts.

zh.claim: 把自己的字变成真字体，在拉丁文这边已经降到「拍一张照、全程不上传」（draw-your-font，5 天 535 星）——但中文一套国标字体要 6763 个汉字，「少样本补字」这一侧没有任何产品。
zh.does: 照着模板手写一页，拍张照，本地就生成可安装的 TTF/WOFF 字体——Node 命令行加一个 Claude Code 技能，什么都不上传。
zh.why_good: 照着模板手写一页拍张照，本地直接出可安装字体，不用账号、不用服务器、不上传。
zh.why_use: 一个人身上不可复制的东西只有两样，一样是声音，另一样就是他的字。把还在世的长辈的笔迹做成字体，家里此后印的每张贺卡、每副春联、每封家书都带着它。
zh.gap: 它只在字母表很小的语言里成立。非拉丁语系用户一上手就撞墙，中文更是要手写 6763 个字——这正是普通人的中文手写字体基本不存在的原因。
zh.counter: 字库公司早就在卖手写风格的中文字体，管线现成；少样本补字要做到能看是真的技术风险，一笔生成得别扭，母语读者一眼就出戏。
zh.differentiator: 打的是补字这道坎，不是字体导出：手写 300 字、补出常用 1000 字，交付的不是字体文件而是一件情绪成品——一副用奶奶笔迹排好的春联，或一封家书。冷启动（中文）：小红书、B 站「手写字体制作」教程下的评论区，那里全是写到一半放弃的人；再加知乎「如何制作一款自己的中文字体」回答区的追问。冷启动（英文）：r/fonts 与 r/typography 搜 handwriting font。
zh.value: 按字体收费，春联、纪念册、卡片这类印品做复购。
zh.risk: 生成汉字的质量就是产品本身；笔画一歪，情绪价值直接反转。
zh.hook: 想把还在世的长辈的笔迹印在明年春联上的人——手写几千个字，写到一半放弃了。

hook: Anyone with a living grandparent whose handwriting they want on next year's spring couplets, who gave up halfway through writing out thousands of characters by hand.
consumer_angle: Ordinary Chinese users could create a personal font from a single photo of their handwriting, without technical setup.
pick_reason: Verified pain for Latin scripts, but the Chinese gap is unproven and the wedge is unclear.
